title: Lior and the Drop
author: Cyrus Eriksen
blurb: Edmund Thackeray, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
